title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta7

## Scheduler round recovery

This beta fixes a positional Custom Schedule state-machine bug observed after a
zone completed successfully but the scheduler did not continue to the next
queue slot or start the next round.

### Preserve the active queue slot

A retained/pre-upgrade scheduler task can have an `active_zone_id` while its
`active_queue_slot` is missing. The queue migration previously marked the
matching slot as started but did not restore `active_queue_slot`.

That meant the mower could later report a confirmed zone completion while the
scheduler recorded only:

- zone completed;
- queue slot started;
- queue slot not completed.

The started-but-not-completed safety guard then correctly refused a fresh reset,
but the round could never advance.

0.5.0-beta7 restores both the started flag and the exact
`active_queue_slot` identity when a retained active zone can be mapped
unambiguously to the current round queue.

### Recover already affected beta6 runtime

The beta also repairs the persisted beta6 field state without requiring users
to disable/re-enable Schedule or edit the queue.

Recovery runs only when all of these are true:

- Custom order is active;
- there is no active, pending or resumable scheduler task;
- the scheduler positively recorded `owned_zone_completed`;
- `just_completed_zone_id`, `zone_completed:<id>` and
  `scheduler_completed_at` agree;
- exactly one started-but-not-completed queue slot matches that completed zone.

If duplicate-zone queue slots make the identity ambiguous, recovery stays
fail-closed and sends no mower command.

### Repeated Time window rounds

The existing Time window behavior is preserved: while the configured window is
still open, finishing every slot completes the current round, the scheduler
waits for a normal Docked/Paused boundary, increments `round_index`, snapshots
the configured queue and starts the next round.

This release changes the integration only. Navimower Map Card 0.4.0-beta6
remains compatible.
